mission: Tenant School Studio Day-1 Magic — 3-act opening sequence

files_created.purpose: Day1MagicService coordinator + PaletteVariation NamedTuple + deterministic rules-based palette fallback + atomic lock-in writer + SiteSettings mirror
Act 1 — animated brand reveal (logo + name + extracted seed colour chip)
Act 2 — three palette variation cards with portal-tile + marketing-tile + login-chip previews
Act 3 — confirmation + animated lock check + cockpit hand-off CTA
Wrapper that conditionally renders the active act + bottom progress rail
Choreographed sequence stylesheet — hero-stage layout + bottom progress rail + per-tone live preview tokens
Act transitions + live variation preview + <dialog> lock confirmation + fetch+CSRF submit + armed-attribute set synchronously
Service + view tests (36 cases: is_day1_required, resolve_brand_seed, generate_variations, lock, reset, cross-tenant 403, role gate)
LogoUploadValidator happy path (PNG/JPEG/WebP) + reject paths (SVG/GIF/oversize/empty/non-bytes) + extract_brand_seed_from_logo
Day-1 contract verifier — partials exist, URLs wired, hub view + template gate on day1_required, static assets present, no on-device LLM URL

files_modified.purpose: Added 4 day1 views (Act1View, Act2View, Act3LockView, ResetView) + redirect into act1 when Day1MagicService.is_day1_required(school) AND ?skip_day1=1 absent + day1_required + day1_reset_url context for the hub template
Wired 4 URL names: tenant_studio_day1_act1 (GET), tenant_studio_day1_act2 (GET/POST), tenant_studio_day1_act3_lock (POST), tenant_studio_day1_reset (POST)

Added LogoUploadValidator(image_bytes) -> (bool, str) with magic-byte MIME sniffing (PNG/JPEG/WebP allowed; SVG/GIF rejected; 1.5MB cap) + extract_brand_seed_from_logo(school) lazy theme_intelligence wrapper + tenant-isolation-allow marker
Conditional include of tenant_studio_day1_orchestrator.html when day1_required; re-run brand session form when palette already locked

act_2_palette_generation.ai_path: services.ai_palette.generate_palette_from_seed (E1 — already shipped; PaletteResult dataclass coerced to 5-stop dict via _coerce_ai_palette_result)
act_2_palette_generation.rules_fallback: deterministic per-tone hue shift on hex channels — guaranteed 3 variations even with TypeError/ImportError

act_3_lock_in.persists_to: School.branding_metadata.palette_locked_at + palette_locked_variation_id + palette_locked_tone + palette_locked_by_user_id + primary + accent + palette_stops
act_3_lock_in.cross_tenant_guard: variation_id is sha256(school.pk + tone + seed_hex)[:16] — service refuses lock when id doesn't match any variation generated against current school; view returns 403 JSON

ai_fallback_proof.import_error_path: ImportError on services.theme_intelligence or services.ai_palette is caught lazily inside each service method; sequence still ships 3 variations from the deterministic rules generator
ai_fallback_proof.type_error_path: When E1 ships with a signature drift (observed during this wave: E1's generate_palette_from_seed takes mode='dual' not tone=), the outer try/except TypeError falls back to a positional-only seed call OR the rules generator
ai_fallback_proof.test_proven_by: GenerateVariationsTests.test_ai_unreachable_returns_rules_fallback (patches __import__ to raise ImportError on services.ai_palette and asserts len(variations) == 3)
ai_fallback_proof.live_log_quote: day1: ai_palette mode=classic raised for tenant=a8cee3ee — using rules

ai_fallback_proof_quote: day1: ai_palette not yet available for tenant=<hash> — using rules for all three tones

verifier_results.scan_off_token_colors_new_findings: 0 (Day-1 CSS uses semantic tokens only; pre-existing 107 in static/marketing/css/* are untouched)

tenant_isolation_proof.service_signature: Every public method accepts ``school: School`` as the first positional arg; no thread-locals; no implicit context
tenant_isolation_proof.cross_tenant_lock_guard: variation_id is school-pk-bound via sha256(school.pk + tone + seed_hex)[:16]; lock_palette_choice generates fresh variations against the request.school and rejects ids that don't match — test_act3_rejects_cross_tenant_variation_id asserts 403
tenant_isolation_proof.school_brand_assets_marker: # tenant-isolation-allow: school-brand-asset-owned-by-school-fk-only at top of day-1 logo block
tenant_isolation_proof.pii_log_safety: _school_log_label(school) hashes slug to sha256[:8] before every logger call; no email, no name, no slug in plaintext

binding_constraints_audit.e1_lazy_import_with_fallback: OK (ImportError + TypeError + generic Exception paths all covered; tests prove fallback)
binding_constraints_audit.css_semantic_tokens_only: OK (Day-1 CSS uses --surface-*, --text-*, --hairline, --elev-*, --motion-*, --ease-*, --radius-*, --space-* exclusively; no off-token literals introduced)

gaps_open_repo_side: E1 dependency: services.ai_palette is present but its signature uses mode=Literal['light','dark','dual'] rather than the tone vocabulary Day-1 speaks; we adapted via tone_to_mode mapping + generic exception fallback. A future hand-off conversation with E1 could surface a tone-aware overload so AI output drives all three variations instead of one.
E2 dependency: rmc-signature-motion.css tokens (--motion-*, --ease-*) — Day-1 CSS uses fallback values inline (var(--motion-slow, 700ms) etc.) so the choreography still works before E2 ships.

Operator-uploaded logo wired ONLY through LogoUploadValidator; the live upload widget in Act 1 is a future iteration (current Act 1 surfaces seed source 'fallback' + a prompt to set primary colour or upload via the existing /school/theme/ page).
Off-token-colors pre-existing drift (107 findings in static/marketing/css/*) is not a Day-1 regression but should be addressed in a marketing-css focused wave.
